purpose.summary: RTT/1 structural-intelligence engine for detecting, mapping, and analyzing structural faultlines across conceptual, computational, and physical regimes.
purpose.detail: The Structural Faultline Detector identifies structural fractures, discontinuities, instability seams, and faultline propagation across RTT regimes (R1–R4). It provides structural diagnostics for higher-level RTT engines such as Stability Basin Cartographer, Temporal Regime Sequencer, Causality Weaver, and Dimensional Resonance Scanner.

ai.ai_keywords: RTT, structural faultline, fracture detection, instability seam, faultline propagation, structural analysis
ai.ai_purpose: Provide structural-level intelligence for RTT/1 by detecting faultlines, mapping fractures, analyzing instability seams, and evaluating structural stability across conceptual, computational, and physical regimes.
ai.ai_operators: SFD-Detect, SFD-Fracture, SFD-Seam, SFD-Field, SFD-Propagate, SFD-Stabilize
